names.note: Read out of saint.gr's line for 11 Μαρτίου, «Άγιος Σωφρόνιος ο Διδάσκαλος Επίσκοπος Βράτσης της Βουλγαρίας», with the rank words left off.

attestations.note: Not among the names printed by days.pravoslavie.ru for 9 сентября ст. ст. (civil 22 September, checked 2026-08-30); no other day checked.

feast.note: doxologia.ro's day calendar prints him twice: on 22 septembrie, «Sfântul Sofronie, Episcopul Vratsei», and again on 11 martie under the same line. His own life page on that site says «Pomenirea lui se cinstește pe 22 septembrie și pe 11 martie». The folder keeps 22 September, which is the day the corpus already held; the 11 March commemoration is recorded here and is not rendered as a second feast (19 September 2026).

source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 11ης Μαρτίου — «Άγιος Σωφρόνιος ο Διδάσκαλος Επίσκοπος Βράτσης της Βουλγαρίας»

attestations.note: The page heads him «(1739 - 1813)» and holds two sentences: the years, and that «Η Συνοδική πράξη της αγιοποιήσεώς του έγινε από την Εκκλησία της Βουλγαρίας στις 31 Δεκεμβρίου 1964 μ.Χ.» — the synodal act of his glorification was made by the Church of Bulgaria on 31 December 1964. It calls him ο Διδάσκαλος, the Teacher. The Greek calendar sets him on 11 March, which is the second of the two days doxologia keeps for him.
Not checked: pravoslavno.rs was read for 23 August – 19 September 2026 (10 August – 6 September ст. ст.); its page for this day was not read (2026-08-30).

birth.note: The life: born 1739 in Kotel, Bulgaria, „potrivit frumoasei lui autobiografii”.

death.note: The life: „A adormit în pace pe 22 sau pe 23 septembrie în anul 1813”.
